platform-eligibility.evidence: Record the applicable platform decision, account status, approved exception or business model review. Source inspection cannot establish eligibility.

installation-auth.evidence: Exercise new installation, declined consent, uninstall and reinstall with third-party storage blocked. Verify authentication precedes access and tenant identity comes from verified claims.

checkout-consent.evidence: Run buyer accept, decline and abandonment paths. Compare order totals and selected delivery methods before and after every optional action; retain request and order evidence.

billing-lifecycle.evidence: Exercise charge approval, rejection, cancellation, plan changes and reinstallation. Match the advertised price to the charge history and document any approved billing exception.

merchant-copy.evidence: Review actual rendered copy and translations in context. Verify action meaning, substantiation, terminology, recovery guidance and neutral review requests; lexical triggers are candidates only.

listing-content.evidence: Compare every submitted field and image against the running app and source requirement. Review names, branding, claims, pricing placement, languages, geographic limits, tags and image distinctness.

submission-access.evidence: Record current submission assets, reachable test accounts, supported-browser recordings and dashboard contacts. Keep credentials outside committed evidence.

workflow-behavior.evidence: Exercise the exact requirement's successful, empty, loading and failed paths in the applicable surface. Record route, revision, environment and observable outcome.

data-synchronization.evidence: Compare owned records on both sides of the integration after create, edit, delete, retry and out-of-order delivery. Verify tenant isolation and required lifecycle API calls.

api-integration.evidence: Trace the feature's actual requests and extension callbacks. Verify the required API and object semantics, category exceptions, retry handling and resulting Shopify state.

scope-justification.evidence: Map each required and optional permission to an exercised feature. Record restricted-scope approval separately; a manifest string does not prove necessity or access.

transport-security.evidence: Inspect served routes, redirects and TLS validation across configured domains. Test unauthorized requests, tenant separation and callback verification; HTTPS syntax alone proves none of these.

embedded-navigation.evidence: Exercise every primary route, deep link, back action, account connection and disconnection inside Shopify. Verify active navigation, fresh login behavior and approved external-surface exceptions.

rendered-accessibility.evidence: Test rendered pages with keyboard and assistive technology, mobile widths and zoom. Check focus movement, accessible names, contrast, errors, loading announcements and responsive reachability.

forms-and-recovery.evidence: Exercise untouched, edited, invalid, submitted, failed and retry states. Check contextual errors, retained values, save/discard navigation guards and accessible feedback.

modal-interaction.evidence: Open and dismiss overlays through real merchant actions. Verify focus return, Escape behavior, action hierarchy and that unrelated events or timers cannot launch intrusive flows.

onboarding-and-home.evidence: Walk a fresh merchant through setup, dismiss completed guidance and revisit home. Verify integration status, useful ongoing data and explanations for requested information.

promotion-and-entitlements.evidence: Review each promotional and plan-gated state for the relevant surface. Exercise dismissal across sessions, inaccessible features, upgrade routes and non-Plus accounts.

live-preview.evidence: Edit visual settings at desktop and mobile widths. Compare preview updates with the saved result, and verify controls and preview remain usable together where required.

theme-integration.evidence: Install, enable, preview, disable and uninstall the app integration in representative themes. Check editor behavior, asset cleanup, onboarding links and any approved theme-write exception.

admin-metrics.evidence: Supply a complete app-scoped 28-day dashboard or observability export with each required percentile and sample count. Evaluate it with evaluateShopifyPerformance; retain raw provenance.

storefront-performance.evidence: Measure before and after installation with matching store, theme, pages, devices and runner settings. Retain all runs and evaluate the score change; local results do not replace Shopify assessment.

carrier-metrics.evidence: Supply complete 28-day request population, latency percentile and success ratio. Evaluate both carrier-specific and general checkout criteria; do not substitute a synthetic benchmark.

fulfillment-metrics.evidence: Supply complete 28-day fulfillment populations, eligible-order exclusions and timely-response ratios. Evaluate required metrics and inspect raw lifecycle evidence for the selected requirement.

customer-account-flow.evidence: Exercise authenticated account ownership, subscription or return management, expired sessions and a second customer's access attempt. Verify the required customer-account integration.

subscription-lifecycle.evidence: Exercise selling plans, contract updates, cancellation, payment-method changes, portal links, variants, currencies and deferred or prepaid pricing. Reconcile UI, API state and customer communications.

payment-flow.evidence: Exercise the approved gateway's payment, cancellation, failure, refund and test flows on supported browsers and devices. Verify amounts, return destinations and permitted extension targets.

fulfillment-workflow.evidence: Exercise merchant-requested fulfillment, unpaid orders, callbacks, tracking and cancellations. Verify state transitions and required API results, including retries and rejected requests.

sales-channel-flow.evidence: Exercise connection, eligibility, publication, rejection, product feedback, attribution and disconnection. Reconcile the channel UI with Shopify state and buyer checkout.

post-purchase-flow.evidence: Exercise accepted and declined offers, repeated offers, quantity and variant changes, and completion. Reconcile product data and total cost; inspect the exact source restrictions.

donation-flow.evidence: Exercise the donation widget and checkout, then reconcile collection, operating-cost disclosure and merchant-visible distribution evidence with the exact requirement.

blockchain-flow.evidence: Exercise approval gates, purchase, minting, claim delivery and fulfillment tracking in a test environment. Review on-chain payloads for personal information and preserve recipient authorization.

native-jsx-accessibility.boundary: Runs existing Oxlint JSX accessibility rules on native elements. Does not infer custom-element shadow DOM, contrast, keyboard flows or rendered content.

component-types.boundary: Use the official component TypeScript declarations for the actual surface/version. Property types do not enforce UX, slots or meaningful labels; no runtime component-type certification is claimed.

iframe-protection.boundary: Checks one supplied response and verified tenant identity. Caller owns authentication and route coverage; standalone findings are advisory.

webhook-hmac.boundary: Runs valid and invalid signed requests through a caller-supplied isolated handler. Caller owns side effects and real delivery coverage; never use production credentials.

storefront-performance.boundary: Compares supplied mobile before/after evidence using weighted home/product/collection scores. Does not collect runs or prove app setup, matching pages, provenance or platform acceptance.

listing-inputs.boundary: Checks only supplied listing fields, counts, image header dimensions, contained paths and exact duplicate bytes. Omitted fields, decoded image integrity, semantic content, translations and visual similarity require review.
